what: Recall ranking quality issue: with limit, project-wide memories (scope=project) outrank file-specific memories (scope=src/memory/**) because layer priority dominates over scope specificity. A recall for src/memory/store.ts returns 5 project-wide technical memories before any file-scoped ones. The scope specificity tiebreaker is too weak — needs to be weighted higher so file-specific memories surface first for file queries. Round-robin helped for layer diversity but didn't fix the scope relevance problem.
why: Discovered during live testing — aide_recall for store.ts returned PostHog decisions and deployment strategy instead of the embedding fix memory that's actually scoped to src/memory/**. The recall "works" but returns unhelpful results.
